title: Four diffusion models, one small dataset

source.citation: bend-lab results/dimba: ViT vs JiT(DiT) vs HiT vs Dimba-style hybrid on flowers64

posts: Four small diffusion models, same flowers, same 1,200 steps. The plain transformer scored 0.514. The best hybrid scored 0.622. The difference is not the parameter count.
Here is the catch: the hybrid took 1,705 seconds; the others took about 500. Remove its Mamba blocks and the score drops back to exactly the plain model's. One recurrent layer did all the work.
The full comparison, one image and every number: https://github.com/adeerkhan/bend-lab/tree/main/results/dimba 🌐 These are small CPU reference models, not a reproduction of the paper's image quality.
